ideas.idea: Add address, postcode and directions to /visit so body matches the description
ideas.why: The description promises directions but the page body only gives opening days, so this is accurate and concrete.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD for address and opening hours on /visit
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it goes against them.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: List the varieties to back up 'Over forty varieties'
ideas.why: The page names only two varieties, so a list would give real content that people and machines can read.

ideas.idea: Create individual pages per variety and add them to the sitemap
ideas.why: This gives specific landing pages and more crawlable content, and fits a site that claims forty varieties.
It is accurate, since the entries have only <loc>, but it is standard advice with small effect on a three-page site.

ideas.idea: Add a sentence on the home page linking onward to varieties and visit
ideas.why: Navigation already links these pages, so extra in-body links add little.
No openGraph is set, but this is standard link-preview advice that applies to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Add village or county location to the home page title/description
ideas.why: The title lacks a place while the body mentions Herefordshire, so naming the location helps identify who and where the site is.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with Next.js app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: The hand-kept sitemap is accurate with 3 pages, so this is a maintainability tip that applies to any Next.js site.
